home.heroText1: Join our community of travellers, where you can share
home.heroText2: your stories and get inspired for new adventures. Discover new places and find like-minded people!
home.aboutTitle: A project made for people who live to travel
home.aboutText: We believe every journey is a unique story worth sharing. Our platform brings together people who love discovering something new. Share your experience, make friends and get inspired for the next adventure with us.
home.missionText: Bringing people together through a love of adventure and inspiring new discoveries.
home.authenticText: We value real, unedited impressions from travellers all over the world.
home.communityText: Become part of a community where everyone can be both an author and a reader.
home.joinAlt: Night sea with a coral reef underwater and mountains on the horizon
home.joinText: Join travellers who share their stories and inspire new adventures.

editorial.title: Stories are published by the editors
editorial.text: We removed sign-up: you don't need an account to read, save stories or book guides. Want to share a trip? Send it to the editors.
editorial.point1: Saved stories live in your browser — no password needed.
editorial.point2: The editors proofread the text, pick freely licensed photos and publish it under your name.
editorial.point3: Booking calls and guided walks works without an account — an e-mail is enough.

create.title: Publish a story
create.subtitle: New stories come through the editors — that keeps the quality and the photos honest.
